lines.text: This is how agents use websites today. Page by page: read, count, repeat.
Forty-nine seconds, twenty-three tool calls, about four hundred thousand tokens. For one question.
Same task. Same model. This time, the website is a command.
Done in twenty-one seconds. Same answer.
clify turns websites into CLIs and MCP tools for agents.
A headless browser clicks through the site, and clify records the request behind every click.
That becomes typed commands. One help page, and any agent knows the whole site.
We've built one hundred and twenty-five of them, and re-checked every one live today.
Then we raced: twenty real tasks, three ways, every answer graded against the live site.
Same answers, in just over half the time, with nearly five times fewer tokens.
Anything that changes data waits for a human to confirm.
And if a site shows a CAPTCHA, clify stops. It never solves one.
clify. Give your agent the website as a CLI.
